items.title: Lead capture across channels
items.body: Web form, WhatsApp, Instagram, IndiaMART and your sales inbox into one pipeline. Almost always the first thing we build.

items.title: Instant first response
items.body: Under sixty seconds, personalised, referring to what they actually asked.

items.title: Qualification and scoring
items.body: Against criteria we work out with you on the kickoff call. This is where most of the value sits.

items.title: Routing and assignment
items.body: Right person, right territory, right product line.

items.title: Meeting booking
items.body: The reply carries a booking link, or proposes slots directly.

items.title: Follow-up on enquiries that went quiet
items.body: Two or three nudges, then it stops. Only people who contacted you first.

items.title: Quote and proposal drafting
items.body: From your rate card and past jobs. You approve before anything sends.

items.title: Proposal chasing
items.body: Quote sent, silence. Polite follow-up that escalates with the days.

items.title: CRM hygiene
items.body: Deduplicate, enrich, fill the fields people skip, fix stages that drifted. Dull and valuable, and it needs proper API access to your CRM.

items.title: Deal updates from email threads
items.body: Reads the thread, updates the stage and next step. You confirm each one until it earns trust.

items.title: Renewal and expiry reminders
items.body: Straightforward when the dates live somewhere we can query.

items.title: Churn-risk flagging
items.body: Usage or engagement drops and someone is told. Needs real data behind it to mean anything.

items.title: Ticket and inbox triage
items.body: Classify, tag, prioritise, route. Safe, because nothing is sent to anyone.

items.title: Answering the same fifteen questions
items.body: Instantly, from a knowledge base we build with you.

items.title: Drafting replies to routine tickets
items.body: Your agent reviews and sends. Cuts handling time without risking the relationship.

items.title: Escalation routing
items.body: Anger, cancellation intent, legal words, important accounts — straight to a person.

items.title: Out-of-hours acknowledgement
items.body: An honest holding reply with a real timeframe. Stops the second, angrier message.

items.title: SLA breach alerts
items.body: Needs your ticket system to expose timestamps properly.

items.title: Finding the gaps in your knowledge base
items.body: What got escalated, clustered monthly. Tells you what to answer next.

items.title: Post-resolution follow-up and review requests
items.body: Timing matters more than wording here.

items.title: Client onboarding
items.body: Deal won, and the workspace, documents, kickoff and welcome all just happen.

items.title: Chasing missing documents
items.body: Missing KYC, missing brief, missing assets. Nobody enjoys this and everybody needs it.

items.title: Appointment reminders
items.body: Measurable reduction in no-shows. The easiest number to prove.

items.title: Order and delivery updates
items.body: Status pushed to the customer before they think to ask.

items.title: Meeting notes into tasks
items.body: Transcript in, tasks out, assigned in your tracker. Needs a transcription source.

items.title: Approval routing
items.body: Discounts, refunds, purchase orders. Worth it depending on how painful your current chain is.

items.title: Vendor and supplier chasing
items.body: The same shape as payment chasing, pointed outward.

items.title: Inventory and threshold alerts
items.body: Only if the stock data is trustworthy. Often it is not, and we will say so.

items.title: Payment reminders by invoice age
items.body: Polite, escalating with the age of the invoice, and it stops the moment you are paid.

items.title: Invoice generation and dispatch
items.body: From a trigger you approve. Generating an invoice is fine; taking the money is not.

items.title: Receipt and expense capture
items.body: Photo or email in, categorised row out. Popular, moderately fiddly.

items.title: Reconciliation flagging
items.body: Mismatches surfaced for a person. Never resolved automatically.

items.title: GST return preparation
items.body: Prepared and presented. A person files it. We check your Tally or Zoho plan actually exposes the API before quoting.

items.title: Anything that moves money
items.body: Payments, transfers, trades. One bug ends a business. We do not build it.

items.title: Ad lead forms into your pipeline
items.body: Meta and Google lead forms straight into scoring and an instant reply.

items.title: Review requests and monitoring
items.body: Asked at the right moment, with an alert on anything under three stars.

items.title: Content repurposing
items.body: One long piece into posts, a newsletter, clips. It works, within limits.

items.title: Competitor and mention monitoring
items.body: Cheap to build and easy to show. Honestly, modest real value.

items.title: Social content at volume
items.body: We will usually talk you out of this. The output is commoditised, quality complaints are constant, and it rarely survives three months.

items.title: Cold outbound at scale
items.body: Deliverability damage, legal exposure, and it would make us the spam vendor. We build reply handling for outbound you send yourself.

items.title: Application screening
items.body: Against criteria you set. With the application volumes here, this is genuinely worth it.

items.title: Interview scheduling and reminders
items.body: Calendar tetris nobody wants to play.

items.title: Candidate communication
items.body: Acknowledgements, status updates, and kind rejections. The rejections matter more than people think.

items.title: Offer and document generation
items.body: Templated, and a person approves.

items.title: Internal employee FAQ
items.body: Leave policy, reimbursements, IT requests. Internal-facing, so a mistake is cheap.

items.title: Weekly numbers, every Monday
items.body: Pulled from your tools, written up, outliers called out.

items.title: Anomaly alerts
items.body: Revenue drop, ticket spike, conversion fall. The value is in choosing the threshold, not the plumbing.

items.title: Sync between tools
items.body: Sheets to CRM to Notion. Boring, a little brittle, sometimes exactly what you need.

items.title: Standup and status summaries
items.body: For engineering teams. Small, easy, useful.

items.title: Incident alert routing
items.body: Grouped, deduplicated, summarised, sent to the right person.

items.title: WhatsApp broadcast to bought lists
items.body: It gets your number banned and breaks WhatsApp's rules. Opt-in lists through approved templates only.

items.title: Anything irreversible with nobody checking
items.body: Unless you ask for it in writing and understand exactly what you are accepting.

items.title: Scraping behind a login
items.body: Including anything that needs a CAPTCHA solved. It puts your accounts at risk, not ours.

items.title: Medical, legal or financial advice
items.body: Generated by a model and sent to your customers. Not something we will build.

items.title: Replacing a person's judgement
items.body: Where being wrong is expensive and nobody is checking the output.
